receipt.equivalence_review: Successful power.input text search returned the two exact complete contracts, independently cross-checked against all pinned catalog blocks; both eligible input blocks require fixed 5 V, incompatible with the mandatory 12 V N1 function/interface/source. Typed CHECK_FAILED at functions.power_input replays from the original pinned brief. No invented records or treatment of query errors as catalog absence.

refusal.reason: The power.input catalog search returned block:usb-c-5v-sink and block:usb-c-usb2-sink. Both are AGENT_VERIFIED and both fix parameters.output_voltage to 5 V. N1 requires 12 V for power_input, also bound by power.sources.input_12v and interfaces.input, and expressly prohibits a 5 V USB substitution. The required 12 V operating point conflicts with every eligible input block's fixed contract; changing that contract or inventing a 12 V block is outside the closed-world catalog.
